sustained.title: Sustained Node throughput - c32
sustained.comment: Aggregate completed requests per second across 50 balanced 500 ms windows, including final drain. The mean and percentiles describe individual window rates; response validation runs outside each timed window. Higher is better.

burst.title: 16-request Node burst completion
burst.comment: Elapsed time for all 16 requests in each finite burst to complete, without replacement requests. Response validation follows the timer. Lower is better.

sequential.title: Warm sequential response latency
sequential.comment: Complete warm HTTP response latency using the streaming API, including fixture fetching, rendering, and stream consumption. Lower is better.

retention.title: Post-GC server heap across retention checkpoints
retention.comment: Post-GC retained memory in the stated workload. Lower is better; this is distinct from allocation volume.

bars.title: SSR response size
bars.comment: Complete SSR document bytes for the same incident page. This includes framework resumption and controlled comparison data.

responseComposition.title: Where the response bytes come from
responseComposition.comment: Disjoint categories of complete SSR response bytes, including semantic markup, document envelope, framework markers, identity attributes, hydration scripts, and controlled comparison data.
